facts.value: Three categories of applicants may qualify for a UL Language Exemption: 1. Applicants with a Department of Education and Skills (DES) Language Exemption from primary or post primary school. 2. Applicants without a DES Language Exemption but are exempt from taking a language due to the findings of a psychological report. 3. Applicants educated / part-educated outside of the Republic of Ireland.
